name: multiparent-unit
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.proof-witness.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; BAPA_MULTIPARENT_CONTROL="$OUT/control" bun test research/bapa/proof-witness.test.ts research/bapa/source-projection.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/control"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; cp -a "$OUT/control/.lake" "$OUT/control-bad-second/.lake"; cd "$OUT/control-bad-second"; set +e; lake env lean BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/bad-second.log" 2>&1; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -ne 0; grep -Eq 'BapaProof[.]lean:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: error:' "$OUT/bad-second.log"; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): check every retained witness parent in Lean' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; cd "$ROOT"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1; rm -rf "$OUT/control/.lake" "$OUT/control-bad-second/.lake"

name: multiparent-firewall
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture p1-historical/symbolic-firewall --sha256 2ed5690066d27705a905eca1dc338612f19c0ed09a59d9f16d79a956ef33c14e --projection witness --out "$OUT/project" > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/research/bapa/witness-source-verify.ts" "$OUT/project" "$OUT/lean.log" "$OUT/SOURCE-CHECKED.json" > "$OUT/source-check.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/research/bapa/multi-parent-witness-controls.ts" "$OUT/project" "$OUT/lean.log" > "$OUT/receipt-controls.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake"
